verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents a public programmatic API across several SDKs. The docs show table search, delete, column transforms, index creation and embedding functions in Python, TypeScript and Rust, and remote `db://` tables authenticate with API keys that work in every SDK, so the story's core of driving the product through a documented API is covered. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed openapi paths return 404), and independent corroboration of API documentation quality (one community user calls the docs poorly written).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the embedding API in LanceDB -- registry, functions, schemas, and multi-language SDK support.
API keys — a long-lived shared secret passed as `api_key` on connect. Works in every SDK.
